headline: Bradespar Approves Dividend Distribution and Interest on Equity Shareholder Payments
summary: Brazilian investment holding company Bradespar approved a distribution of dividends and interest on equity, payable to shareholders registered as of September 22, 2026.
why: Bradespar is a major Brazilian investment firm holding significant equity stakes in major domestic resource companies.

impacts.name: Bradespar S.A.
impacts.why: The cash distribution approval directly provides returns to common and preferred equity holders.
